claims.text: Merges go through a script that pins the exact commit being merged and refuses if any check is still pending or failing.
It has refused me twice when a branch moved under me
a model name typed by hand
a file moved while something still points to the old path
a page whose text wraps badly at some screen width
The ledger refuses edits; a correction is a new row that names the old one.
What is not yet proven: whether these receipts make my calls better over time.
